hook: The love letter Feynman wrote, and never sent

beats.say: Richard Feynman married Arline Greenbaum in 1942, though lymphatic tuberculosis was expected to kill her within two years.
He worked at Los Alamos while she lay in a sanatorium in Albuquerque. On June 16, 1945, she died at 9:21 in the evening.
A year and a half later he wrote her a love letter and never sent it because, as he put it, he did not know her new address.
